subject: Request: Blue Harbor reference & logo use — draft and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Blue Harbor reference & logo use — draft and next steps

Hi Marta,

Thanks again for the thoughtful demo last week — the team at Blue Harbor has one of the clearest LLM-inference production stories we’ve seen and I wanted to ask whether you’d be comfortable letting Redwood publish a short case study and use Blue Harbor’s logo in marketing materials.

What we’d like to do:
- Publish a ~600–800 word customer spotlight on our website and share a one-page PDF with sales.
- Use the Blue Harbor horizontal logo in the header and include a short quote (if you’re ok).

Attached is a draft case study (rdw-case-study-draft-v1.docx) and a short mutual action plan with milestones. If it helps, we can limit distribution to web + sales collateral only.

Next steps we propose:
1) Your permission for logo and quote usage.
2) Blue Harbor legal signs a short reference release (I’ve cc’d our marketing lead Laura).
3) We finalize the draft and send the web-ready asset for your final sign-off.

If you prefer, we can route the release through DocuSign — happy to take whichever process Blue Harbor uses.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: rdw-case-study-draft-v1.docx
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@blueharbor.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brand Ops <brandops@blueharbor.com>, Blue Harbor Legal <legal@blueharbor.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Blue Harbor reference & logo use — draft and next steps

Hi Ben — thanks for sending this over and for the kind words. We’re generally open to customer spotlights but I need to loop in Brand Ops and Legal for logo usage and the release.

A few quick clarifications for our Brand Ops team:
- Could you confirm the exact logo files and sizes you’ll use on the site (vector preferred)?
- Will the quote appear as verbatim from our team, and who will you attribute it to?

To Legal (cc’d): can you review the attached draft release once Ben sends it formally? We prefer to review and return a redline rather than full edits in-line.

I’ll aim to get Brand Ops’ guidance and Legal’s initial availability by end of week.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Partnerships
Blue Harbor Health
marta.lopez@blueharbor.com

Hi Marta and team — appreciate the quick reply. Per Brand Ops’ ask, attached are:
- two vector logo files (blueharbor_logo_horizontal.svg, blueharbor_logo_lockup.png) — exported in RGB for web
- the current case study draft with the proposed quote attributed to Jose Alvarez, Head of Ops

We’ve attached a short reference release template we typically use; Laura and Stephanie are cc’d on legal.

-ben
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Blue Harbor Legal <legal@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Reference release — Redwood x Blue Harbor (redline attached)

Hi Marta / Blue Harbor Legal team — Stephanie here from Redwood legal. Ben forwarded the template; I’ve attached a redlined version (redline_reference_release.pdf) with two minor edits we typically request:

1) Narrow the permitted uses to “website, sales collateral, and customer events” (no paid ads unless separately approved).
2) Standard confidentiality carve-outs for non-public performance metrics.

If those look acceptable, we can prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature — please let us know whether Blue Harbor prefers a single signature from an authorized signatory or countersignature.

For tracking: Ben, Laura — we’ll need Blue Harbor’s preferred attribution line for the quote (name + title) and a final high-res logo for the web asset.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Commercial Agreements
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redline_reference_release.pdf

Hi Stephanie / Ben — thanks for the redline. Blue Harbor Legal reviewed and accepted the edits with one small change to Section 3 (we added a clause to clarify we retain rights to product names and trademarks). We’ve signed the attached release (blueharbor_signed_release.pdf) and are returning logo files in the formats you requested.

Files attached: blueharbor_signed_release.pdf, blueharbor_logo_horizontal.svg, blueharbor_logo_lockup.png

One quick copy request from Brand Ops: please change the opening sentence in the case study to say “Blue Harbor Health standardized inference across production workloads using Redwood Inference’s Dedicated runtime” (Brand prefers the word “standardized” vs. “streamlined”). Otherwise we’re good to publish once you incorporate that edit.

Marta Lopez
Head of Partnerships
Blue Harbor Health
marta.lopez@blueharbor.com
